title: OpenAI prices GPT-6 Sol and Luna for an agentic split
teaser: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna with permanent API prices starting at $0.10 per 1 million input tokens. Sol costs $2 per 1 million input tokens and $10 per 1 million output tokens, half the price of GPT-5.6 Sol. Luna targets simpler, high-volume work at $0.10/$0.50, while Astra remains the company’s top-end model for difficult, multimodal and scientific tasks. The release is less about one model replacing another than about making model routing part of the product.
